scope: Ten question-level material claims, indexed from existing reconciliations with specific later corrections. Not an exhaustive atomic-claim ledger, primary-source revalidation, new NIST/UAF observation matrix, accepted Sherlock state or completed investigation.
authority: Main-repository CHARTER.md controls scope; primary sources and unit records control evidence. This index cannot override them.

R.role: derivative synthesis; table Ten question dispositions and Eight causal links; follow its linked unit records for primary pins

C.role: derivative changed-evidence assessment; corrections and stable-case qualification

B.role: record of partial user listening; not original audio or completed event inventory

F.role: executed synthetic software-test report; not historical evidence

E.role: exploratory image/candidate-pixel record, no accepted model discrepancy

claims.question: Q01
claims.claim: Reviewed exterior imagery contains fire-consistent and flame-like appearances; it does not establish a complete interior exposure history or uniformly mild heat.
locators: C: Figure5-121 addition and correction to mild-fire wording
claims.dependency: Visibility, façade/floor identification, time and source-family assignments
claims.counterpoint: Obscuration can conceal fire; apparent flame also requires discrimination from reflection. Visible flame alone does not measure temperature or structural sufficiency.
claims.next_discriminator: Authenticated, timed observations covering hidden or opposite-side regions, with explicit visibility and exposure joins.
claims.replication_ceiling: Index inherits unit-level image readings, not new independent annotation.

claims.question: Q02
claims.claim: Reported fire-input prescriptions, substitutions and mismatches require testing; the indexed work does not establish their historical thermal exaggeration or downstream structural effect.
locators: R: Q02 row, D1/D2 and causal links1-2
claims.dependency: D1,D2; matched quantity/location/time and active solver semantics
claims.counterpoint: A modeling substitution can be defensible; a mismatch can also be consequential. Neither direction follows without the applicable histories and sensitivities.
claims.next_discriminator: Recover matched native exposure/state histories and solver semantics; compare justified alternatives without guessing repeated-node behavior.
claims.replication_ceiling: Source-content audit is not historical heat-field reproduction.

claims.question: Q03
claims.claim: Visible interior/penthouse-related movement precedes later façade descent in reviewed records; exact hidden-member order and some cross-source timing remain unresolved.
claims.dependency: D8; original-camera/master chronology and physical-feature joins
claims.counterpoint: Editing or clock differences can alter cross-source ordering; visible early motion does not identify the failed member or initiating mechanism.
claims.next_discriminator: Authenticate common-event timing and camera/master mappings, retaining inconsistent orderings rather than retiming to fit.
claims.replication_ceiling: Existing conditional timings are not direct observations of hidden columns.

claims.question: Q04
claims.claim: Existing roof-motion calculations constrain the observed feature conditionally; they do not establish the center-of-mass acceleration of a defined whole-building material body.
locators: R: Q04 row and motion discriminator
claims.dependency: Projection/deformation bounds, material-body definition and clock calibration
claims.counterpoint: Positive late curvature remains evidence. Uncertainty is not evidence of arbitrarily large error. Near-g COM motion would constrain net non-gravitational force, not each reaction separately.
claims.next_discriminator: Independently bound the relation between tracked feature and defined-body COM before deriving a relative-force limit.
claims.replication_ceiling: Reproduced arithmetic does not supply the missing feature-to-body mapping.

claims.question: Q05
claims.claim: Selected observations support apparent co-motion and mostly vertical descent, not complete three-dimensional symmetry or total footprint containment.
claims.dependency: Multi-view geometry, feature identity, visibility and debris-state mapping
claims.counterpoint: Outside fragments do not negate rapid predominantly vertical motion; a flat projected roofline does not establish equal motion at every depth.
claims.next_discriminator: Calibrated multi-view trajectories and traceable debris observations with out-of-plane uncertainty.
claims.replication_ceiling: Selected feature correspondence is not complete volumetric reconstruction.

claims.question: Q06
claims.claim: Developed fire-triggered pathways and component tests provide conditional support, but the actual timed transition from local damage to global loss of surviving support is not independently demonstrated.
locators: R: Q06, D3-D6/D9 and causal links3-7
C: stable-case addition and paired-test requirements
claims.dependency: D3-D6,D9; actual case states, residual connections/contact, loads and reaction/energy histories
claims.counterpoint: The reported stable case is positive model-level evidence that local damage need not force global collapse. Failed bolts do not necessarily remove bearing or restraint. Conversely, unavailable full reproduction does not erase empirical component support.
claims.next_discriminator: Reproduce authenticated failing and arrest cases unchanged, enumerate all differences, then vary justified factors while retaining force, energy and timing diagnostics.
claims.replication_ceiling: No matched native-case historical reproduction; graphical calibration measurements remain unaccepted.

claims.question: Q07
claims.claim: Recorded reports and partial listening do not authenticate an explosive event; inherited acoustic evidence has only conditional adverse weight against studied conspicuous blast scenarios.
locators: R: Q07 and A11 for audio; A01 concerns Camera3 appearance only
B: preserved response and prior edit-audit cross-reference
claims.dependency: Actual listening coverage, source/edit history, microphone opportunity and synchronized timing
claims.counterpoint: A spoken explosion report is evidence of what was reported, not automatically a recorded blast. Nondetection requires an opportunity to detect; quiet mechanisms are not excluded by the loud-blast argument.
claims.next_discriminator: Complete the outstanding listening observations, then authenticate candidate timing and recording-specific detectability.
claims.replication_ceiling: B is a partial human response, not an independent listener or completed event inventory. The older statement that B has no response is superseded.

claims.question: Q08
claims.claim: The comparator work supports feature-specific mechanical lessons, not matched causal odds or a population base rate for WTC7.
locators: C: competing explanations and qualification of model evidence
claims.dependency: Independent cause/method labels and structural, exposure, preweakening and recording comparability
claims.counterpoint: Plasco includes reported heat-generated local failure; that is not a demonstrated complete WTC7-like historical chain. R1 concerns a different building and its completed human review must not be reopened as a WTC7 requirement.
claims.next_discriminator: Use only independently grounded, feature-matched comparisons; stronger causal odds would require a defensible sampling and label model.
claims.replication_ceiling: Human-reviewed R1 lowering remains conditional and does not validate the two failed broad AI arms.

claims.question: Q09
claims.claim: Reviewed municipal and procurement records support ordinary explanations for specific activities, while installed-state, event-day, operational and custody links remain incomplete.
locators: R: A02-A10, source families and Q09
claims.dependency: Original records, installation/inspection closure, event chronology and custody
claims.counterpoint: R specifically retains a substitute fuel pump and seven unfinished items in the reported July31,1999 test despite readiness language; persistence and significance in2001 are unknown. Legitimate work can coexist with wrongdoing, but coexistence is not affirmatively shown here. Missing records or benefit do not prove an operation; ordinary records do not establish universal innocence.
claims.next_discriminator: Authenticate an operation-specific contemporaneous record or material-custody/handling contradiction and obtain genuinely independent corroboration.
claims.replication_ceiling: Copies of one test or transaction remain one underlying source; exhausted bounded searches do not prove archive-wide absence.

claims.question: Q10
claims.claim: The synthetic Faraday export experiment now establishes bounded executed behavior; it does not establish scientific validity, two-way Sherlock admission, or native model availability.
locators: F: What passed and Observed limitations
claims.dependency: Exact source/state chains, destination resolution, review boundaries and scientific controls
claims.counterpoint: Export accepts certain unresolved references and changed/missing exploratory raw sources; successful structural validation is not current-byte custody or scientific validation. Detector repeatability likewise does not establish curve identity.
claims.next_discriminator: Retest claimed software fixes with synthetic adverse controls before use; obtain exact missing model records separately. Real case transfer requires its own authority.
claims.replication_ceiling: Two136-check matrix runs agree semantically and nine native tests passed as reported. These supersede the old pre-export failure status, not the preserved failed runs.
